decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template builds on the firm's deep shop-hosting know-how and supports its agency customers, but it sits at the edge of its core hosting competence and got only a passing mention on the website.
The responsive website template uses the firm's existing CMS expertise at low maintenance cost, though website design is peripheral to hosting and the product had weak visibility.
Premium support extends the firm's central competence of round-the-clock expert service, so it can easily read customer feedback and refine the offer.
The version management tool fits the firm's continuous in-house tool development for developers and agencies, and its own product page shows strategic commitment.
The data processing contract tool answers GDPR demand among hosting customers and builds on the firm's security and compliance know-how, but its legal content needs ongoing upkeep.
